info.title: Parse API
info.description: Programmatic API for creating, managing, and executing web scraping APIs.

post.summary: Create a new API from a URL
post.description: Submit a website URL to generate an API. If a matching API already exists, returns it instantly. Otherwise, queues a job to build one. Optionally describe the data you need in the `task` field.

get.description: List all dispatch tasks for the current user, with optional status filter and pagination.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status (queued, running, completed, failed, needs_input)

get.description: Get full details for a dispatch task, including the generated API spec with endpoint definitions and execution URLs when completed.

post.description: Send a response when the agent requests user input during API creation. Task status must be 'needs_input'.
Submit a revision request for a completed API. Describe what to change — the system will classify and queue the revision.
Cancel an in-flight build or revision task. Only tasks in a non-terminal state (queued, running, needs_input) can be cancelled.

409.description: Task is already in a terminal state

get.summary: Get the in-flight task for a scraper
get.description: Return the active (queued/running/needs_input) revision or extension task for a given scraper, if any. Useful for showing live progress on an API you already own. Returns `{ "task": null }` when nothing is in flight.
Get a code example showing how to call this API using the Parse SDK.
List all revisions (child tasks) for a given task.

get.summary: Get a callable API's OpenAPI document
get.description: Return the complete OpenAPI 3.1 document for an API you own or an active marketplace canonical. Optionally pin it to an available version snapshot.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Pin the document to a version snapshot. Marketplace canonicals accept release versions only; omit for the live document.

ETag.description: Strong validator for the returned document.

API-Snapshot-Version.description: The pinned version, when version was requested.

404.description: The API or requested version is unavailable to the caller.

get.description: Export a completed API as MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool definitions. Returns tool names, input schemas, and endpoint metadata.
Compare your API against the canonical version to find new or updated endpoints. Returns a list of changes you can preview and merge.

canonical_scraper_id.description: ID of the canonical scraper (present when updates exist)

post.description: Apply selected endpoint updates from the canonical version into your API. New endpoints also merge code; spec-only updates preserve your code.
Restore your API to its pre-merge state. Only the most recent merge can be rolled back.
Test an endpoint against the canonical version to see the updated behavior before merging. Returns the execution result plus sample inputs.

200.description: Execution result from the canonical version

sample_inputs.description: Pre-fill data from canonical for this endpoint

get.description: Search the public marketplace of pre-built APIs. No authentication required. Returns hybrid-ranked results when `q` is provided, or a browseable list ordered by `sort` otherwise. Use this to find an existing API for a site before building your own with POST /dispatch.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search across API name, description, and endpoints.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Ordering when not searching: 'top' (highest rated), 'recent' (newest), or 'name' (A→Z).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO-2 country code for region-aware ranking (e.g. 'US').

parameters.name: semantic
parameters.description: Include the semantic (embedding) ranking arm when searching.

get.description: Search across individual endpoints in the marketplace (not just APIs). No authentication required. Returns two groups: matching APIs and matching endpoints. Useful when you know the data you want but not which API provides it.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO-2 country code for region-aware ranking.

200.description: Combined API and endpoint search results

get.description: Full detail for one marketplace listing, including its `canonical_scraper_id` and endpoint list. No authentication required. Use `canonical_scraper_id` to call the shared canonical directly: POST /scraper/{canonical_scraper_id}/{endpoint_name}.

post.description: Create your own copy of the canonical, pinned to its current release and added to your account (My APIs). Returns a `scraper_id` you call at POST /scraper/{scraper_id}/{endpoint_name}. Pinned, so upstream changes don't alter your contract until you merge updates. Stays sync-eligible.
Create a private, desynced copy of the canonical: no upstream merges, and your revisions don't propagate back. Returns a `scraper_id` you own and call at POST /scraper/{scraper_id}/{endpoint_name}.

get.description: Call a generated API endpoint using query parameters. Use GET when the endpoint spec defines GET as the method. Parameters are passed as query strings and auto-coerced to the correct types.

200.description: Success — the endpoint's own JSON (shape defined by its return_schema).

post.description: Call a generated API endpoint by scraper ID and endpoint name. Pass endpoint parameters in the JSON body.

schema.description: Endpoint-specific parameters (see the endpoint's input_params for the schema)

200.description: Success — the endpoint's own JSON (shape defined by its return_schema).

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key for programmatic access. Create one in the Parse dashboard at https://parse.bot (Settings → API Keys). Keys start with 'pmx_'.

StaleInput.description: 422 — your input was invalid or the resource is gone upstream (`status: stale_input`). Fix the input and retry.

RateLimited.description: 429 — rate limit exceeded. Honor the Retry-After header.

error.message: Too many requests in a short burst. Retry in 5s.

ScraperError.description: 500 — the scraper crashed or hit a bug (`status: error`). Not your fault; revise the API.

error.message: The scraper crashed during execution. This could be due to bad input, broken scraper code, or a website update.

UpstreamError.description: 502 — the TARGET SITE returned a non-2xx (`status: upstream_error`). This is NOT a Parse outage; inspect upstream_status_code + snippet before retrying.

error.message: The target site returned HTTP 404. See `snippet` for the upstream response body.

Blocked.description: 503 — anti-bot blocked every proxy (`status: blocked`). Retry later only if retry_after is present.

error.message: Service temporarily unavailable - site protection blocking all proxies

url.description: Website URL to generate an API from

task.description: Natural language description of the data you need (e.g. 'get product prices and reviews')

contributes_to_marketplace.description: Whether this API contributes to the shared marketplace canonical for its domain. TRUE (default) = your revisions feed back into the canonical, you can merge upstream improvements, and the build is free. FALSE = the API is fully desynced from the canonical and the build is charged. This is a permanent, per-API choice and cannot be toggled later. (The old `force_new` field has been removed — sending it now returns a 400.)

allow_auth.description: Permit this build to proceed when the site requires a login. Programmatic (API key / MCP) callers must opt in: an authenticated build pauses at status=needs_input waiting for credentials, consumes a per-domain auth session, and runs as a private build. Requires a paid plan and a one-time disclaimer acceptance in the Parse dashboard. Setting this does NOT assert the site needs auth — that verdict stays server-side.

workspace.description: Build this API directly into the caller's team workspace instead of their personal space, so every teammate can see and revise it. Requires a workspace on a Team plan; otherwise the dispatch is rejected with 402 rather than silently landing as personal.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier — use this to poll for status

matched.description: True if an existing API was found for this URL

test_inputs.description: Suggested test parameters for each endpoint (when matched)

may_require_auth.description: True if the task likely requires authentication credentials

status.description: Task lifecycle state. Poll until it reaches a terminal state: completed, failed, or cancelled.

user_input_prompt.description: Present when status is 'needs_input' — the question(s) the agent needs answered. Respond via POST /dispatch/{task_id}.

result_scraper_id.description: Set on completion — the scraper_id used to execute endpoints.

auth_enabled.description: True if this API was built against a site that requires login.

source.description: How the user acquired this API.

progress.description: Live build progress while status is 'running' (stage, headline, per-endpoint status, log).

initiates_session.description: True for a login endpoint that returns a session — see Authenticated APIs.

user_response.description: Key-value pairs responding to the agent's input prompt

revision.description: Natural language description of what to change (e.g. 'add a search by category endpoint')

contributes_to_marketplace.description: Whether this revision contributes back to the shared marketplace canonical. TRUE (default) = the revision propagates upstream and is free. FALSE = the revision desyncs this API from the canonical and is charged. The opt-out is permanent.

task_id.description: ID of the revision task (may be the original if no agent run was needed)

revision_type.description: Always 'revision' — a single agent handles all revision types

ScraperRunResponse.description: On success (HTTP 200) the body is the endpoint's own JSON — the shape described by its return_schema — not a fixed wrapper. This generic schema documents the fallback fields present when output can't be parsed. See the ExecutionError schema for non-2xx responses.

status.description: Present on fallback/error envelopes; absent on a normal successful response (which is just the endpoint's data).

ExecutionError.description: Non-2xx execution envelope. `error` is either a string or an object whose `status` field (success/stale_input/upstream_error/blocked/error) tells you the failure category — see the Errors guide.

error.description: A message string, or a detail object with a machine-readable `status` and context.

endpoint_name.description: Name of the endpoint with an available update

type.description: 'new' if the endpoint didn't exist when you cloned, 'updated' if the canonical version changed

user_has_called.description: Whether you've previously called this endpoint

endpoints.description: Endpoint names to merge from canonical

code_merged.description: Whether scraper code was also updated (true when new endpoints are merged)

id.description: Marketplace listing id. Use it with GET /marketplace/apis/{id} (detail + canonical_scraper_id), or /subscribe and /fork.

is_authenticated.description: True if the API requires login.

MarketplaceDetail.description: Full listing detail. additionalProperties is allowed — only the fields most useful for calling the API are documented here.

canonical_scraper_id.description: The shared canonical scraper id. Call it directly with any API key: POST /scraper/{canonical_scraper_id}/{endpoint_name}.

apis.description: The API's endpoints (method, name, input_params, return_schema, initiates_session).

pinned_version.description: The version your subscription is pinned to, if you've subscribed.

user_status.description: Your relationship to this API (when authenticated).

user_scraper_id.description: If you've subscribed or forked, your own scraper_id to call instead of the canonical.

canonical_scraper_id.description: The shared canonical id (the 'global' URL you can also call directly).

scraper_id.description: Your private, desynced copy — call POST /scraper/{scraper_id}/{endpoint_name}.
